name: EQT Holdings Limited
summary: EQT Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides specialist trustee services in Australia. It operates through Trustee & Wealth Services and Corporate Trustee Services segments. The company offers asset management, estate planning and management, philanthropy, wealth management/advice; and personal, charitable, health and personal injury, and community trust services. It also provides corporate trustee, custody and real assets, and debt securitization services; and corporate shared services, such as legal and company secretariat, people, finance, risk management, marketing, and technology.
